```{r}
#| message: false

## Attach exons
txdb_f <- "gencode_v48_txdb.sqlite"
if (!file.exists(txdb_f)) {
  txdb <- txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF("gencode.v48.annotation.gtf.gz")
  AnnotationDbi::saveDb(txdb, file = txdb_f)
} else {
  txdb <- AnnotationDbi::loadDb(txdb_f)
}

exons <- GenomicFeatures::exonsBy(txdb, by = "tx")
txps <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  txdb,
  AnnotationDbi::keys(txdb, "TXID"),
  c("TXNAME", "GENEID"),
  "TXID"
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::mutate(TXID = as.character(TXID))

stopifnot(
  "txps txid does not match" = match(txps$TXID, names(exons)) |>
    identical(seq_len(length(exons)))
)

names(exons) <- dplyr::case_when(
  stringr::str_detect(txps$TXNAME, "ENST") ~ txps$TXNAME,
  TRUE ~ paste0(txps$GENEID, "-", stringr::str_sub(txps$TXNAME, 1, 8))
)

slice_indx <- match(rownames(se), txps$TXNAME, nomatch = 0L)
txps <- txps[slice_indx, ]
# txps <- txdb$txps |>
# filter(tx_nms)

se <- se[txps$TXNAME, ]
stopifnot(all.equal(rownames(se), txps$TXNAME))
exons <- exons[slice_indx]
rownames(se) <- names(exons)
rowData(se)$exons <- exons

```

```{r}
xp <- new_plyxp(se)
xp <- xp |>
  filter(
    rows(rowSums(.assays_asis$counts >= 10) >= 6)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rows(
      gene_id = unlist(gene_id),
      gene = stringr::str_replace(gene_id, "\\.\\d+", ""),
      symbol = AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
        org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
        gene,
        "SYMBOL",
        "ENSEMBL"
      ),
      symbol = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(symbol) ~ gene,
        TRUE ~ symbol
      )
    ),
    cols(
      condition = dplyr::case_when(
        condition == "ctrl" ~ "WT",
        condition == "exp" ~ "KD"
      )
    )
  )
head(table(table(rowData(xp)$gene_id)))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(DESeq2)

set.seed(314)
dds <- xp |>
  mutate(
    counts = round(counts) |> as.integer(),
    train = rbinom(n(), counts, prob = 0.5),
    test = as.integer(counts - train)
  ) |>
  plyxp(
    DESeqDataSet,
    design = ~condition
  )

assay(dds, "avgTxLength") <- NULL

# estimate sizeFactors on original counts
dds <- plyxp(dds, estimateSizeFactors) |>
  # before computing DESeq, make "counts"
  # into training data
  mutate(
    old_counts = counts,
    counts = train
  ) |>
  # run DESeq2 where counts == train
  plyxp(DESeq)

```

```{r}
# extra functions
select_common_rows <- function(se, common_rows) {
  new_plyxp(se) |>
    dplyr::select(
      rows(all_of(common_names)),
      everything(),
      cols(everything())
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    se()
}

des_res2rows <- function(se, coef, ...) {
  res <- DESeq2::lfcShrink(se, coef = coef, ...)
  rowData(se)[names(res)] <- res
  se
}
fmt_log <- function(nums, digits = 0) {
  template <- paste0("%s%.", digits, "f")
  sign <- rep("-", length(nums))
  sign[nums > 0] <- "+"
  sprintf(template, sign, abs(nums))
}

#' @param object a dds object that had been predicted
#' @param new_data a different dds object that will take the priors of `objec`
#' @param coef string indicating the coef design to use for shrinkage
#' @param type glm type.
#' @export
predict_dds <- function(object, new_data, coef, type = "apeglm") {
  if (!is.null(sf <- sizeFactors(object))) {
    sizeFactors(new_data) <- sizeFactors(object)
  }
  new_data <- estimateDispersionsGeneEst(new_data)
  dispersionFunction(new_data) <- dispersionFunction(object)
  new_data <- estimateDispersionsMAP(new_data) |>
    nbinomWaldTest()

  res <- lfcShrink(object, coef = coef, type = type)
  pc <- attr(res, "priorInfo")$prior.control
  res <- lfcShrink(
    new_data,
    coef = coef,
    type = type,
    apeAdapt = FALSE,
    prior.control = pc
  )
  metadata(new_data)$shrink_results <- res
  new_data
}
```

```{r}

system.time({
  res <- dds |>
    new_plyxp() |>
    mutate(rows(
      simple_exons = simple_range(exons),
      n_children = 1L
    )) |>
    group_by(rows(gene_id)) |>
    mutate(
      rows(
        n_transcript = n(),
        cut_n_transcript = cut(
          n_transcript,
          c(2, 6, 10, Inf),
          include.lowest = FALSE
        )
      )
    ) |>
    filter(rows(!is.na(cut_n_transcript))) |>
    mutate(
      rows(
        nodes = cluster_data(simple_exons, similarity_method = "basepair") |>
          tree_vctr()
      )
    ) |>
    arrange(rows(nodes))
}) |>
  print()
res

system.time({
  xp_inner <- group_by_nodes(res, rows(inner_nodes(nodes))) |>
    summarise(
      across(everything(), colSums),
      rows(
        n_children = n(), gene_id = gene_id[1],
        # storing exons
        exons = list(exons)),
    )
}) |>
  print()

res_inner <- plyxp(
  res,
  predict_dds,
  new_data = DESeq2::DESeqDataSet(se(xp_inner), design = design(se(res))),
  coef = "condition_WT_vs_KD",
  type = "apeglm"
)
print(res_inner)

```

```{r}

common_names <- intersect(
  rowData(res_inner) |> names(),
  rowData(res) |> names()
)

# rowRanges(se(res_inner)) <- NULL
.res <- res
rr <- rowRanges(se(res))
rowRanges(se(res)) <- as(rr, "CompressedGRangesList")
# for completeness, and so we can track the source
# of each merge if we are curious later
res <- res |> ungroup() |> mutate(
  rows(
    # converting CompressedGRangesList to a list of
    # CompressedGRangesList
    exons = as.list(exons) |>
      lapply(\(r) relist(r, PartitioningByEnd(length(r))))
  )
)

mcols(rr) <- NULL

inner_desc <- res_inner |> {
  \(se) {
    nodes <- pull(se, rows(nodes))
    # returns all node ids needed to construct
    desc_nodes <- descendants(nodes)
    mapply(
      \(node, wt, trees) {
        treeClustDemo:::new_pure_tree_vctr(
          node = node,
          which_tree = vec_rep(wt, length(node)),
          tree = trees
        )
      },
      node = desc_nodes,
      wt = vctrs::field(nodes, "which_tree"),
      MoreArgs = list(trees = trees(nodes)),
      SIMPLIFY = FALSE
    )
  }
}()

# much faster than doing an lapply
rowRanges(se(res_inner)) <- inner_desc |> {
  \(inner, leaf, rr) {
    lens <- lengths(inner)
    ends <- cumsum(lens)
    unlistData <- vctrs::list_unchop(inner)
    # match inner node desc against observation leaf nodes
    ind <- match(unlistData, leaf)
    # use indices to slice original rowRanges
    rr <- rr[ind]
    # construct CompressedGRangesList
    new(
      "CompressedGRangesList",
      unlistData = rr,
      elementMetadata = rowData(res_inner),
      partitioning = IRanges::PartitioningByEnd(x = ends)
    )
  }
}(leaf = rowData(res)$nodes, rr = rr)
```

```{r}

.se <- rbind(
  select_common_rows(res, common_names),
  select_common_rows(res_inner, common_names)
) |>
  new_plyxp() |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    rows(.features = as.character(nodes))
  ) |>
  plyxp(des_res2rows, coef = "condition_WT_vs_KD")
```

```{r}
climb_se <- .se |>
  group_by(rows(gene_tree = tree_id(nodes))) |>
  mutate(rows(
    keep_strict = climb(nodes, pvals = pvalue, which = gene_tree[1]),
    keep_ord = climb(nodes, pvals = pvalue, which = gene_tree[1], method = "ord")
  ))
```

```{r}
strict <- climb_se |>
  filter(rows(keep_strict)) |>
  mutate(
    counts = as.integer(test),
    rows(
      train_res = tibble::tibble(
        baseMean, baseVar, log2FoldChange,
        lfcSE, pvalue, padj, condition_WT_vs_KD,
        SE_Intercept, SE_condition_WT_vs_KD )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    counts, old_counts,
    rows(nodes, n_children, gene_id, exons, train_res),
    cols(everything())
  )
```

```{r}
.se_data <- climb_se |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(rows(
    gene_id == rowData(multi_sig_trans)$gene_id[1],
    is_leaf(nodes))) |>
  mutate(cols(
    col_nodes = hclust(dist(t(.assays_asis$test))) |> tree_vctr()
  ))



plot_data <- .se_data |>
  mutate(
    rows(
      train = .assays$train,
      test = .assays$test,
      col_tree = .cols$col_nodes,
      condition = .cols$condition,
      feature = .features,
      sample = .cols$.samples
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(rows(nodes, exons, train:sample)) |>
  rowData() |> tibble::as_tibble()


hclust_plot <- tree_plot_data(all_nodes(tree_vctr(plot_data$nodes)))

exon_data <- plot_data |>
  dplyr::select(nodes, exons, feature) |>
  mutate(
    nodes = tree_vctr(nodes), #drop other trees
    start = lapply(exons, \(r) start(unlist(r))),
    end = lapply(exons, \(r) end(unlist(r))),
    gstart = vapply(start, min, 1),
    gend = vapply(end, max, 1),
    exons = NULL
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest(c(start, end)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(hclust_plot, by = "nodes") |>
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = unique(feature)))

ggplot(exon_data, aes(feature)) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = gstart, yend = gend)) +
  geom_rect(aes(width = 0.75, ymin = start, ymax = end), fill = "steelblue")
```
